Immigration Law

Your immigration status is the foundation of what you're building in the United States. A flawed strategy doesn't just delay your case — it can cost you years of progress and erode the stability you've worked to establish. We build immigration strategies for global professionals, founders, and investors — EB-1, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and family-based pathways — for clients who cannot afford to get this wrong.
